# `Rsa` — RSA signatures (RFC 8017)

## Documentation

| Call | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Rsa.verifyPkcs1v15(publicKey, hash: h, message: m, signature: s)` | whether `s` is the RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 signature of `m` under the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo `publicKey` |
| `Rsa.verifyPss(publicKey, hash: h, message: m, signature: s)` | whether `s` is the RSASSA-PSS signature of `m`, with MGF1 over `h` and a salt as long as the digest |
| `Rsa.signPkcs1v15(privateKey, hash: h, message: m)` | the RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 signature of `m` under the DER PKCS #8 `privateKey`, exactly as long as the modulus |
| `Rsa.signPss(privateKey, hash: h, message: m, salt: salt)` | the RSASSA-PSS signature of `m` under the DER PKCS #8 `privateKey`, exactly as long as the modulus |

A public key is an `rsaEncryption` SubjectPublicKeyInfo with NULL parameters, a modulus of 2048 to 4096 bits
that is odd, and an odd exponent `e` with `3 <= e < n`. A private key is a PKCS #8 `PrivateKeyInfo` holding a
two-prime `RSAPrivateKey` with the same modulus and exponent rules, whose values agree: `p * q == n`,
`e * d == 1` modulo `p - 1` and `q - 1`, `dP` and `dQ` are `d` reduced modulo `p - 1` and `q - 1`, and
`qInv * q == 1` modulo `p`. Both are strict DER, read with `DerReader`.

The checks run in order, and the first that fails decides the `RsaError`:

1. the key: `invalidPublicKey` or `invalidPrivateKey`;
2. the signature length for verification, `invalidSignatureLength` unless it is exactly the modulus length;
   the salt length for PSS signing, `invalidSaltLength` unless it is exactly the digest length.
   `signPkcs1v15` has no second check.

Every other malformed signature verifies as `false`, never an error.

The vectors are the canra `rsa-verify` and `rsa-pss-sign` specs, generated mechanically from their JSONL:
102 of the 110 verification vectors and 38 of the 43 signing vectors. The 13 left out name a hash
`HashAlgorithm` cannot spell (`UnsupportedHash` has no counterpart): `verify-err-015`, `verify-err-016`, `verify-err-017`, `verify-err-018`, `verify-err-019`, `verify-err-020`, `verify-err-027`, `verify-err-028`, `sign-pss-err-015`, `sign-pss-err-016`, `sign-pss-err-017`, `sign-pss-err-022`, `sign-pss-err-023`.

The canra `rsa-pkcs1-sign` spec adds 34 of its 39 vectors, with the same key rules and DigestInfo prefixes; the 5 left out name a hash `HashAlgorithm` cannot spell: `sign-pkcs1-err-015`, `sign-pkcs1-err-016`, `sign-pkcs1-err-017`, `sign-pkcs1-err-018`, `sign-pkcs1-err-019`.

## Tests

<!-- test: rsa.verify-pkcs1v15 -->
The `verify_pkcs1v15` vectors: NIST CAVP SigVer15, Wycheproof, and computed keys of 2048, 2049, 3071 and 4096 bits and with `e = 3`.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function errorName(failure RsaError) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidPublicKey gives "invalidPublicKey"
		invalidPrivateKey gives "invalidPrivateKey"
		invalidSignatureLength gives "invalidSignatureLength"
		invalidSaltLength gives "invalidSaltLength"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function reportPkcs1v15(id String, keyHex String, hash HashAlgorithm, messageHex String, signatureHex String)
	if let valid = try Rsa.verifyPkcs1v15(fromHex(keyHex), hash: hash, message: fromHex(messageHex), signature: fromHex(signatureHex)) 'checked'
		print("{id} {valid}\n")
	end 'checked' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'reportPkcs1v15'
```

<!-- test: rsa.verify-pss -->
The `verify_pss` vectors: NIST CAVP SigVerPSS, Wycheproof, computed keys including a `1 mod 8` modulus, and salts of the wrong length.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function errorName(failure RsaError) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidPublicKey gives "invalidPublicKey"
		invalidPrivateKey gives "invalidPrivateKey"
		invalidSignatureLength gives "invalidSignatureLength"
		invalidSaltLength gives "invalidSaltLength"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function reportPss(id String, keyHex String, hash HashAlgorithm, messageHex String, signatureHex String)
	if let valid = try Rsa.verifyPss(fromHex(keyHex), hash: hash, message: fromHex(messageHex), signature: fromHex(signatureHex)) 'checked'
		print("{id} {valid}\n")
	end 'checked' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'reportPss'
```

<!-- test: rsa.verify-refusals -->
The verification error vectors that `HashAlgorithm` can express: malformed and out-of-range public keys, and signatures of the wrong length.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function errorName(failure RsaError) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidPublicKey gives "invalidPublicKey"
		invalidPrivateKey gives "invalidPrivateKey"
		invalidSignatureLength gives "invalidSignatureLength"
		invalidSaltLength gives "invalidSaltLength"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

function reportPkcs1v15(id String, keyHex String, hash HashAlgorithm, messageHex String, signatureHex String)
	if let valid = try Rsa.verifyPkcs1v15(fromHex(keyHex), hash: hash, message: fromHex(messageHex), signature: fromHex(signatureHex)) 'checked'
		print("{id} {valid}\n")
	end 'checked' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'reportPkcs1v15'

function reportPss(id String, keyHex String, hash HashAlgorithm, messageHex String, signatureHex String)
	if let valid = try Rsa.verifyPss(fromHex(keyHex), hash: hash, message: fromHex(messageHex), signature: fromHex(signatureHex)) 'checked'
		print("{id} {valid}\n")
	end 'checked' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'reportPss'

function main() returns ExitCode

	reportPkcs1v15("verify-err-002", keyHex: "", hash: HashAlgorithm.sha256, messageHex: "63616e7261207273612d76657269667920636f6d707574656420766563746f72", signatureHex: "")
```

<!-- test: rsa.sign-pss-nist -->
The NIST CAVP SigGenPSS vectors: a 3072-bit key with SHA-256 and SHA-384 and a salt as long as the hash.
```maxon
function digit(symbol Byte) returns Byte
	if symbol >= 0x61 'letter'
		return symbol - 0x57
	end 'letter'

	return symbol - 0x30
end 'digit'

function fromHex(hex String) returns ByteArray
	var bytes = ByteArray.create()
	var high = 0 as Byte
	var isHigh = true

	for symbol in hex.bytes() 'eachSymbol'
		if isHigh 'first'
			high = digit(symbol)
		end 'first' else 'second'
			bytes.push(high * 16 + digit(symbol))
		end 'second'

		isHigh = not isHigh
	end 'eachSymbol'

	return bytes
end 'fromHex'

function toHex(bytes ByteArray) returns String
	var text = ""

	for byte in bytes 'eachByte'
		text.append("{byte:02x}")
	end 'eachByte'

	return text
end 'toHex'

function errorName(failure RsaError) returns String
	return match failure 'name'
		invalidPublicKey gives "invalidPublicKey"
		invalidPrivateKey gives "invalidPrivateKey"
		invalidSignatureLength gives "invalidSignatureLength"
		invalidSaltLength gives "invalidSaltLength"
	end 'name'
end 'errorName'

	if let signature = try Rsa.signPss(fromHex(keyHex), hash: hash, message: fromHex(messageHex), salt: fromHex(saltHex)) 'signed'
		print("{id} [{toHex(signature)}]\n")
	end 'signed' else (failure) 'refused'
		print("{id} {errorName(failure)}\n")
	end 'refused'
end 'reportSignPss'
```
